speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: I must clarify that based on your symptoms of a rapidly growing, painless breast mass, a diagnosis of Gastroenteritis is incorrect as that condition affects the gastrointestinal tract. Could you confirm if you have any history of recent infections or systemic illnesses like fever or weight loss? REQUEST TEST: Ultrasound of the breast.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Ultrasound of the breast Findings: Hypoechoic mass with a leaf-like architecture and internal hyperechoic foci. The lesion demonstrates significant posterior acoustic shadowing and non-parallel orientation (taller than wide).
